native_rule.creator: bhanu.nandanampati@nopalcyber.com
native_rule.name: [NopalCyber] [TEMP] IR - Powershell Downloading File
native_rule.s1ql:
(
  object.type = 'Process' AND event.type = 'Process Creation'
) AND (
  tgt.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'powershell' AND
  tgt.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'downloadstring' AND (
    tgt.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'Invoke-Expression' OR
    tgt.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'IEX' OR
    tgt.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'bypass' OR
    tgt.process.commandLine contains:anycase ' -b ' OR
    tgt.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'hidden' OR
    tgt.process.commandLine contains:anycase ' -h '
  )
) AND NOT (
  process.commandLine contains:anycase 'choco' OR
  process.commandLine contains:anycase 'Kaseya' OR
  process.commandLine contains:anycase 'Backup' OR
  process.commandLine contains:anycase 'Agent' OR
  process.commandLine contains:anycase 'InstallerToken' OR
  process.commandLine contains:anycase 'Polic' OR
  process.commandLine contains:anycase 'Reinstall'
) AND site.name contains:anycase ' ir '
